## Quarto listings in this portfolio

A Quarto listing automatically organizes documents into a collection of cards, a table, or a list. This page uses a grid to bring together my CEP, analytics, and communication projects.

Each card draws its title, description, date, and categories from the project document's metadata. Search, category filters, and sorting help readers find relevant work. When project documents are added or updated, the collection reflects those changes after the website is rendered.

The listing is connected to the `projects/` folder:

```yaml
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort-ui: true
```

This approach keeps the portfolio organized without manually maintaining every project link.

[Reference: Quarto document listings](https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-listings.html)
